title: 宇宙的68%是个数学错误？
title_en: Is 68% of the Universe a Math Mistake?

segments.zh: Sixty eight percent of the universe
segments.en: 宇宙的百分之六十八，

segments.zh: might not exist.
segments.en: 可能根本不存在。

segments.zh: We're talking about dark energy.
segments.en: 说的是暗能量。

segments.zh: This week, a team of mathematicians took a swing at it.
segments.en: 这周，几位数学家冲它挥了一拳。

segments.zh: A new paper says Einstein's own equations
segments.en: 新论文说，爱因斯坦自己的方程

segments.zh: might explain the universe without it.
segments.en: 也许不用暗能量就能解释宇宙。

segments.zh: Today's brain teaser:
segments.en: 今天的烧脑问题：

segments.zh: can a pencil standing on its tip knock over cosmology?
segments.en: 一支立在笔尖上的铅笔，能推倒整个宇宙学吗？

segments.zh: First, the mystery. The universe is expanding,
segments.en: 先说谜题：宇宙在膨胀，

segments.zh: like bread dough rising in an oven.
segments.en: 就像烤箱里发起来的面包。

segments.zh: Galaxies are the raisins.
segments.en: 星系是面包里的葡萄干，

segments.zh: They all drift apart from each other.
segments.en: 彼此越离越远。

segments.zh: Gravity should slow that down,
segments.en: 引力本该让膨胀变慢，

segments.zh: like a ball thrown up slows as it rises.
segments.en: 就像往上扔的球越飞越慢。

segments.zh: But in nineteen ninety eight, astronomers watched distant exploding stars
segments.en: 可是一九九八年，天文学家看遥远的爆炸恒星，

segments.zh: and found the opposite.
segments.en: 发现正好相反。

segments.zh: The expansion is speeding up.
segments.en: 膨胀在加速。

segments.zh: That discovery won a Nobel Prize.
segments.en: 这个发现拿了诺贝尔奖。

segments.zh: Imagine throwing a ball up
segments.en: 想象你往上扔个球，

segments.zh: and watching it go faster and faster.
segments.en: 它越飞越快。

segments.zh: Something must be pushing.
segments.en: 一定有东西在推。

segments.zh: Scientists named that something dark energy.
segments.en: 科学家给它起名叫暗能量。

segments.zh: In the standard model, dark energy is about sixty eight percent
segments.en: 按标准模型，暗能量占宇宙的

segments.zh: of everything in the cosmos.
segments.en: 大约百分之六十八。

segments.zh: And nobody knows
segments.en: 可它到底是什么，

segments.zh: what it actually is.
segments.en: 没人知道。

segments.zh: Twist one: the idea is old.
segments.en: 反转一：这个点子很老了。

segments.zh: Einstein added a similar term in nineteen seventeen.
segments.en: 爱因斯坦一九一七年就加过类似的一项。

segments.zh: He reportedly called it his biggest blunder.
segments.en: 据说他后来称之为一生最大的错误。

segments.zh: Then it came back.
segments.en: 结果它又回来了。

segments.zh: The new paper comes from UC Davis and University College London,
segments.en: 新论文来自加州大学戴维斯分校和伦敦大学学院，

segments.zh: in a Royal Society journal.
segments.en: 发表在英国皇家学会的期刊上。

segments.zh: Their target is the standard model of the cosmos,
segments.en: 它瞄准的是宇宙的标准模型，

segments.zh: the one with dark energy built in.
segments.en: 就是自带暗能量的那个。

segments.zh: Here's the pencil.
segments.en: 来看这支铅笔。

segments.zh: You can balance it perfectly on its tip.
segments.en: 你可以让它完美地立在笔尖上。

segments.zh: Mathematically, that's a real solution.
segments.en: 数学上，这是个真解：

segments.zh: All the forces cancel.
segments.en: 所有的力正好抵消。

segments.zh: But one tiny breath of air,
segments.en: 可只要一丝风，

segments.zh: and it falls.
segments.en: 它就倒了。

segments.zh: Twist two, the surprising one:
segments.en: 反转二，最意外：

segments.zh: they say our model of the universe is that pencil.
segments.en: 他们说，我们的宇宙模型就是这支铅笔。

segments.zh: They found it's unstable.
segments.en: 他们算出它不稳定：

segments.zh: Tiny ripples on huge scales grow instead of fading.
segments.en: 超大尺度上的小涟漪会长大，而不是消失。

segments.zh: The lead author argues
segments.en: 论文作者认为，

segments.zh: that nature doesn't pick unstable solutions.
segments.en: 不稳定的解，大自然不会选。

segments.zh: So what if the universe already slid off the balance point?
segments.en: 那如果宇宙早就从平衡点滑开了呢？

segments.zh: In their picture, that slide could look like acceleration.
segments.en: 在他们的图景里，这一滑，看起来就像加速。

segments.zh: And it would need
segments.en: 而且，

segments.zh: no dark energy at all.
segments.en: 根本不需要暗能量。

segments.zh: Twist three: this paper isn't alone.
segments.en: 反转三：怀疑暗能量的不只这篇论文。

segments.zh: Last year, a giant galaxy survey called DESI hinted that dark energy may be changing.
segments.en: 去年，巨型星系巡天DESI暗示，暗能量可能在变。

segments.zh: If it can change,
segments.en: 如果它会变，

segments.zh: maybe it was never a constant to begin with.
segments.en: 它也许从来就不是一个常数。

segments.zh: Fine print: so far this is pure math.
segments.en: 友情提示：目前这还是纯数学，

segments.zh: Nobody has tested it against telescope data yet.
segments.en: 还没拿望远镜的数据检验过。

segments.zh: And many cosmologists still think dark energy
segments.en: 很多宇宙学家仍然认为，

segments.zh: is the best explanation for what we see.
segments.en: 暗能量是对观测最好的解释。

segments.zh: A new idea has to predict something we can measure.
segments.en: 新想法得做出能测量的预言，

segments.zh: That's the next step.
segments.en: 这才是下一步。

segments.zh: So, can a pencil on its tip knock over cosmology?
segments.en: 所以，笔尖上的铅笔能推倒宇宙学吗？

segments.zh: Maybe, if the universe is the pencil.
segments.en: 也许能，如果宇宙就是那支铅笔。

segments.zh: Sixty eight percent of everything
segments.en: 宇宙的百分之六十八，

segments.zh: is riding on a balancing act.
segments.en: 押在一个平衡上。

segments.zh: Either dark energy is real,
segments.en: 要么暗能量是真的，

segments.zh: and deeply weird.
segments.en: 而且怪得要命。

segments.zh: Or our best map of the cosmos
segments.en: 要么我们最好的宇宙地图，

segments.zh: has been standing on its tip all along.
segments.en: 一直都立在笔尖上。

elements.text: what if it already slid off?
